KPI Green Energy Limited has informed the Exchange about  revision in time of Analysts/ Investors Earnings Conference Call. The Conference Call will now be held on Friday, November 13, 2026, at 04:30 PM.
voiceSummary: KPI Green Energy Limited has revised the timing of its conference call with investors and analysts. The call, scheduled for Friday, November 13, 2026, to discuss unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, will now commence at 4:30 P.M. IST. This is a change from the previously announced time of 02:30 P.M. IST. The event will feature Whole Time Director Moh. Sohil Yusufbhai Dabhoya, Executive Director Rajesh Shrivastava, Group CFO Kapil Kriplani, and CEO BESS Erez Schreiber. Registration details and dial-in numbers are provided via Ernst & Young LLP. All other details from the earlier intimation dated November 07, 2026, remain unchanged. The revised invite is hosted on the company website.

attchmntText: TITAGARH RAIL SYSTEMS LIMITED has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Titagarh Rail Systems Limited confirms no deviation or variation in the utilization of proceeds from convertible warrants issued on a preferential basis for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company raised Rs. 199.99 Crores on November 4, 2025. As of June 30, 2026, Rs. 49.99 Crores was received as upfront consideration. The remaining 75 percent will be received upon exercise of conversion options within 18 months. Funds were allocated for working capital loan repayment of Rs. 100 Crores, general corporate purpose of Rs. 49.99 Crores, and reimbursement of capital expenditure of Rs. 50 Crores. No amount was utilized during the reported quarter. Care Ratings Limited serves as the monitoring agency. The statement is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended 30.09.2026
voiceSummary: Titagarh Rail Systems Limited filed a Monitoring Agency Report with BSE and NSE for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The report covers the utilization of proceeds from a Preferential Issue of 21,11,932 Convertible Warrants aggregating Rs. 199.99 crores. CARE Ratings Limited issued the report. The company received Rs. 50.00 crores, representing 25% of the issue price. Rs. 50.00 crores was utilized for the reimbursement of capital expenditure. No funds were utilized for working capital loan repayment or general corporate purposes during the quarter. The total unutilized amount stands at Rs. 50.00 crores. There were no deviations from the objects of the issue. The monitoring agency noted that the current market price is lower than the warrant issue price of Rs. 947 per share but higher than the exercise price of Rs. 710.25 per share. Management expects promoters to exercise the warrants within the exercise period.

attchmntText: TITAGARH RAIL SYSTEMS LIMITED has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Titagarh Rail Systems Limited approved its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 10, 2026. The Board considered the Standalone and Consolidated results along with the Limited Review Report from auditors Price Waterhouse & Co Chartered Accountants LLP and Salarpuria & Partners. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the company reported Revenue from Operations of Rs. 14,623.2 crores and a Profit for the Period of Rs. 150.70 crores. Earnings Per Share for continuing operations was Rs. 8.47 on a diluted basis. The Board meeting commenced at 04:30 P.M. and concluded at 06:15 P.M. The disclosure is available on the company website at www.titagarh.in.

attchmntText: Laurus Labs Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Laurus Labs Limited has intimated the schedule of analyst and institutional investor meetings pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The company will participate in the Avendus Spark Annual Investor Conference on November 17, 2026, in Mumbai. The interaction will be conducted through in-person meetings. The date of the meeting is subject to change due to exigencies on the part of investors or the company. attchmntText: TITAGARH RAIL SYSTEMS LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Titagarh Rail Systems Limited has scheduled a Q2 and H1 FY27 Earnings Conference Call for Friday, 13th November 2026 at 4:00 PM IST. The meeting will be conducted via audio call for analysts and investors. attchmntText: Tata Consultancy Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet

attchmntText: ICICI Bank Limited has informed the Exchange about Disclosure under Regulation 30 read with para A of Schedule III and Regulation 46(2) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015

attchmntText: Divi's Laboratories Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Divi's Laboratories Limited filed newspaper clippings with the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited regarding the publication of unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The results were published on November 08, 2026, in the Financial Express English daily across all editions and in the Andhra Prabha Telugu daily for the Hyderabad edition. attchmntText: Larsen & Toubro Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
voiceSummary: Larsen & Toubro Limited has secured a significant order from Noida Metro Rail Corporation Ltd for the design and construction of the Noida Metro Aqua Line Extension Project. The Heavy Civil Infrastructure business vertical will handle part design and construction of a 15.1 km elevated viaduct extending from Botanical Garden to Noida Sector-142, and from Depot Station to Boraki. The scope includes building 10 elevated metro stations with architectural finishes. The project is scheduled for completion within 36 months. The order is classified as significant, indicating a value between 1,000 to 2,500 crore rupees. This announcement was issued on November 9, 2026.
